verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's full-height stripe background. They shrink it to three small bars and scatter the price, the vertical URL and the product list across empty white space, and the 'for all drinkware on' line is shrunk to illegible micro-text. That line sits right under the list in A and floats alone at the bottom in B. A is less bad because its price and list are large, fill the height and read clearly. B's list is small and floats in a large dead area, and its sideways URL now outweighs the list.
